data.narrative:
Varda Space Industries, a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov, carries a current post-money valuation of $1.5B against $131M total raised. The peer universe comprises five public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight private peers, including Sierra Space, Skyryse, and Impulse Space at comparable or adjacent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C to subsequent-stage advancement, yielding $2.5B. Peer-median valuation across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies produces $2.0B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue. The public sector median P/S multiple is 23.9x across six tickers, but this method remains inaccessible without target revenue data.

The triangulated range of $1.7B (low) to $2.9B (high), with a median of $2.3B, reflects meaningful divergence driven primarily by peer heterogeneity. Sierra Space's $8.0B valuation as an outlier widened the peer range considerably; excluding it would narrow guidance. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, commercial traction on near-term orbital manufacturing operations, and capital requirements to sustained profitability. The current $1.5B valuation sits in the lower quartile of this derived range, suggesting either market caution or below-median peer positioning within the Space & Aerospace frontier-tech segment.
